style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: HE crosses the frame edge to edge in EVERY beat, talking ones too, the kitchen streaking past HIM; HE fills half the frame height, the camera riding level with HIM; a new angle and one impulse per beat; never a held pose or a prop worked in place; THE CRAB works at the lens, never the subject
character: a glossy red lobster, long whipping antennae, ONE huge claw and one small, smug and pleased with himself
second_characters: ONE plump crab in a bow tie, hauling coins and the jar at the lens all clip, never still
props: ONE wooden table; ONE glass jar of yellow butter; ONE stack of coins; ONE lemon; ONE folded paper sheet, huge print ТАЛОНЫ НА ЕДУ, dotted perforation lines splitting it into coupons; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the jar is in frame all clip, never still; the butter is inside it until 1.55 and smeared on him after; the sheet hides behind HIS OWN antenna until 8.55, then stays in his claw; the print is seen, never spoken
environment: a sunlit seaside kitchen, tall window, white tiles

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, smug, even 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: BAN-ke, TOL-ka MAS-lom, YES-li, in-ves-TEE-ruy, v ye-DU, never YE-du
audio.pacing: 0.9-3.1 one breath; one pause only, 3.1-3.8; 3.8-6.45 one breath; after 6.45 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open on every syllable, no voice over
audio.sfx: butter squelch, claw snaps, coins spilling, paper snapping open at 8.55, a coupon tearing at 9.45, a wet bite at 9.6

timeline.a: a red claw sweeps across the lens and clears it
he vaults onto the table and the coin stack bursts apart
he charges left to right on his tail, both claws thrown wide, tiles streaking, the crab at the lens
he dives head first into the butter jar and it skids right to left with him
he bursts out glazed and tears left to right, butter flinging past the lens
he skates right to left through the spilled butter, the crab hauling the jar at the lens
he scuttles left to right at the lens, cabinets streaking behind him
he slings right to left, stabbing the big claw at the lens on the run
he boots the table lemon and drives left to right after it, the lemon bouncing ahead of him
he spikes the lemon on the run right to left, juice spraying past the lens
he ploughs the loose coins left to right, coins blasting off the table, the crab surfing them at the lens
he kicks the jar into a roll and runs it right to left, the crab landing on the glass
he tears left to right alongside the rolling jar, antennae lashing it
he rips the folded sheet from behind HIS OWN antenna on the run and snaps it open left to right, the huge print ТАЛОНЫ НА ЕДУ and the dotted perforation lines splitting it into coupons
he drives right to left at the lens, tearing one coupon off along the dotted line on the run, dunking it in the butter smear and biting it, his whole body in frame

must_appear: the crab hauling coins at the lens, he dives into the jar at 1.55 and bursts out glazed, the coins ploughed off the table, the print ТАЛОНЫ НА ЕДУ readable across the sheet at 8.55, its perforation splitting it into coupons, one coupon torn off and bitten at 9.6
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, night, a parked camera, a wide or distant hero, duplicate props, a prop worked in place, paper before 8.55, a human hand, him standing still while speaking, black bands
